summary: Mox is an all-in-one mail server written in Go that handles both sending and receiving messages. It includes built-in support for standard protocols, cryptographic authentication records, spam filtering, and an integrated webmail interface.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to run a complete email stack with minimal external dependencies or complex configuration scripts.
watchOut: Running a self-hosted mail server involves significant operational overhead regarding IP reputation, delivery issues, and constant security maintenance.
deployNotes: As a Go application, it typically compiles down to a single binary that requires persistent storage for mail data and access to standard network ports.
